verdict.rationale: Yapily is a hosted open banking API platform, so self-hosting is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence documents a self-hosted or on-premise deployment of the core product. The OpenAPI spec and client-library generation are developer building blocks for calling the hosted API, and the sandbox is a hosted test environment, not self-hosting.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
